tourismServices.intro1: Turkmen Expo is pleased to offer a full range of services for the successful organization of events in Ashgabat. We provide comfortable accommodation, transportation arrangements, ticket reservations, and support throughout your visit.
tourismServices.intro2: The Archabil Hotel is a five-star complex located just 5.9 km from the center of Ashgabat. It's an ideal location for business delegations and tourists. The hotel offers a variety of rooms, as well as swimming pools, tennis courts, a fitness center, a spa, and a business center. All services are available for your convenience and comfortable stay.
tourismServices.hotelYyldyz: The Yyldyz Hotel is one of the tallest and most prestigious hotels in Ashgabat, boasting panoramic views of the city. It offers comfortable relaxation and business, with luxurious rooms, restaurants, a spa, a fitness center, and swimming pools.
tourismServices.recommendation: We recommend the above-mentioned hotels as they offer ideal conditions for comfortable accommodation and high-quality service.
